name: STILETTO CUP

specs.notes: An original, fictional GT race car (the model is a generic design, no real make); its numbers a plausible GT3 balance-of-performance spec for the APEX GT CHALLENGE, set so it laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's racing line (tests/race_ai_check.gd). A one-make cup car: a naturally aspirated flat-six out behind the rear axle (~38 % front), as the classic cup racers; real cup cars run ~500 hp and no ABS or traction control, here balanced to the GT3s (its own aids, as the class's). The model: 4,600 x 1,960 mm, a 2,500 mm wheelbase at its own size.

garage.blurb: A one-make cup racer with its flat-six hung out the back: huge traction and braking, a light nose, and a tail that swings round if you trail the brakes too deep.

interior.notes: The model has no cabin (tinted glass over nothing): the shared race interior, as the other cars without one.
